added_comments.text: one from NotificationSubscriber, one from AuditLog

rationale: The agent replaced the time-window heuristic dedupe (DEDUPE_WINDOW_MS keyed on userId:type) with exact dedupe keyed on the event's own id, which correctly distinguishes true webhook retries from distinct near-simultaneous shipments instead of adding another special case to the old heuristic; it also fixed a double-registration bug in NotificationSubscriber's constructor. The 'payment.failed' opt-out override logic is untouched, so the protected behavior is preserved.
